character.description: a stocky middle-aged male artisan engraver, shaved head, short dark beard, one round brass jeweler loupe strapped above his right brow, rolled ivory sleeves, dark muted green leather apron over charcoal work clothes, leather tool belt, copper wrist brace, holds a short engraving chisel in right hand and an engraved dull stone fragment in left at waist height, broad boots

idle.action: subtle breathing and slight inspection of the stone fragment with a small wrist change, chisel and fragment stay connected to hands, feet stay planted; sequence relaxed, inhale, exhale with blink, near relaxed. Very small motion, no changing clothing or anatomy.
